Help: How to Add a New Funeral

View Video Instructions

sub_fields.label: First Name(s)

sub_fields.instructions: Also add title if needed, eg Dr, Captain
sub_fields.required_message: First name or initial is required

sub_fields.label: Date field instructions
sub_fields.message:
Dates will be shown below the name eg "1960 - 2022". 
Note: This can be left blank for no dates.

sub_fields.label: Person's Image
sub_fields.instructions:
If no image is added the default fallback image will be displayed.
This fallback image is selected from the settings page

sub_fields.instructions: Copy & Paste the funeral notice here.

sub_fields.instructions: Un-checking this hides the intro "Please join us in celebrating ......."

choices.yes: Hide the intro title "Please join us in celebrating ....." on the page.

sub_fields.label: Hide the Date/Time from the public
sub_fields.name: hide_time
